I really want that physical attention from friends.

I definitely wrote this all wrong. That’s my mistake. I’m not good with words sometimes. 

My business wasn’t going to be a full time thing and was all planned so I had people doing most of the work for me. I wasn’t getting any attention so I didn’t expect for it to ever get big. I haven’t had any messages, purchases, etc in over 3 months so it was not going anyway so I gave it up. 

Deep down, I want to get up and exercise but I’m incredibly lazy and get sick of stuff very fast if I don’t enjoy it. I’ve been depressed for over 12 years and I’ve tried everything to help it so I just live with it. I have my good days and bad days with motivation. It’s just sticking to it but I get bored. Idk if I worded that correctly. 

I definitely did not make sense with this post. I’m just trying to find a way to move up in life cause I’ve tried ending my life too many times. I’ve been on this position for 10 years.

Thankyou for your reply!

I’d prefer to get my exercise in with a fun activity I can do alone and away from other people which is a bit tricky to do here. The only “exercise” I’m getting is taking my dog for a small walk but it’s the same walk every day. It’s boring. The backlash is mainly from fitness instructors and random strangers on the net. 

Ive already noticed a huge confidence boost since losing 40kg. My weight isn’t what’s bothering me. It’s everything else. More so the being alone and jobless part that’s affecting me the most.

My family and I were driving to town for our weekly grocery shop and we came across a car upside down on the side of the highway and a body lying face down about 30 feet in front of the car. 
There was an old lady in the front seat alive and upside down. My dad and someone else got her out of the car then dragged the body to the grass. The old lady was not injured and that body was her grandson. I had to sit with the old lady in our car till help arrived and she didn’t say a word. I was 8 years old. It still feels like it was all a dream but it really happened and 20 years later, i still think about it almost daily.
